_comment: Battle presentation (M7 P2): how units, skills, statuses and the fight's end look and sound. Timings of the attack itself come from data/feel/feel.json (attack_windup + attack_strike + attack_recover) so every screen keeps one rhythm; this file holds what is particular to the battle. Every number here is a first guess, not balance. Read by ui/fight/battle_art.gd and ui/fight/skill_fx.gd.
_enemy_sprites_comment: Enemy table id -> sprite manifest unit, for enemies whose manifest entry has another id. An enemy whose id is a manifest unit (or listed in a unit's enemy_ids) needs nothing here; one with neither draws fallback_enemy.

fallback_enemy._palettes_comment: Picked per enemy type from its id, so two unknown enemy types never look the same by accident. Same format as ally_palettes in data/feel/sprite_manifest.json.

_enemy_tier_comment: Enemy tier by the fight's defense level (index 0 to 5).
_tier_look_comment: What a tier adds around the sprite: the base plate under the unit and a glow in the bot's glow color behind it. glow_alpha 0 is no glow; glow_pulse is how far the alpha breathes, glow_pulse_ms one breath.
_motion_comment: Pixels a unit travels toward its target on a lunge, and recoils on a shot or when hit (before display_scale). reduced motion sets them to 0.
_big_hit_comment: A hit is big when it takes at least this share of the target's max hp, or downs it: big hits get the heavy hit pause and the small screen shake. Every other landed hit gets the light pause and no shake.
_energy_popup_comment: An energy gain popup shows on the unit whose turn comes up when it gained at least this many points since its last turn.
_low_energy_comment: A unit shows the low energy status when it cannot afford its cheapest skill that costs energy.
_downed_alpha_comment: Opacity of a downed unit's card.
_arrow_comment: Intent arrows: alpha of an arrow in the background, and of the one in focus (the next enemy to act, or the enemy under the pointer).
_preview_comment: The choice preview drawn on the bars: the predicted hp loss blinks between these alphas, one blink every preview_blink_ms.

outcome._comment: The victory or defeat moment before the post-fight readout: the banner pops in (feel tween ui_pop), holds, then the screen hands off. A click skips the hold. The skip animation setting skips it all.

effects._comment: Effect sheets: one row of frames each, drawn white and tinted by the skill's color.

_skills_comment: One look and sound per skill. motion: lunge (runs at the target), shoot (recoils, fires projectile), sweep (lunges, then the effect lands on every target), slam (a heavy lunge), blast (charges, then fires a big projectile), cast (heal pose; the effect lands on the target), guard (guard pose; the effect lands on the target). charge_effect plays on the user during the wind-up; projectile flies from user to target during the strike; impact_effect plays on each target. color/accent name data/feel/palette.json colors. sound plays at the strike, impact_sound (a data/feel/audio.json id, or "") on each landing.
_skill_for_comment: Which look a unit's skill uses: its own name first (a bot's Overcharge Shot fights as heavy_strike but looks like itself), then its combat skill id, then its effect. Names match case-insensitively with spaces as underscores.
_level_steps_comment: How a skill's look and sound grow with its level: entry 1 is level 1, up to the max skill level (10, data/post_fight/post_fight.json); a higher level uses the last entry. scale and brightness grow the effects; particles is the burst size on each landing; extra adds projectiles (shot skills), sparks (heals) or rings (guards); impact is the hit pause on a landed hit (light or heavy; big hits are always heavy); layers are extra sounds (data/feel/audio.json) played with the skill's own. The timing never changes: a maxed skill hits harder, not longer.
